readingReview.comparison: My order matches the first reader's and the script. The first reader's concerns: (1) 'his' across the page turn depends on the A-12 link. Resolved by the art: Ravi is the only standing figure and the focus of 04-1, under 'NOW · A-12', after sitting nearest the TV in 03-5, and the nurse names him in the next panel. (2) The nurse appears without introduction. The scrubs, lanyard and BP cuff show her role and the caption names the activity, as the first reader also judged. (3) The zig-zag in 04-2 from the balloon at the right down to Ravi at the left: he does not speak, so the order is unaffected. Accepted. (4) The large empty lower areas in 04-2 and 04-3: the art fills both tall panels (the seated vitals scene; Ananya with the tablet and laptop). Resolved. (5) 'RAVI · READY' read after her face: it sits on the tablet she is looking at. Fine. Nothing unresolved for page 4. The stale assets/panels/05-1.png is passed on for the page-5 work.
